name: lorikeet-reply
description: Drafts a reply to a customer support ticket, in your brand voice, with a short plan: what to check, what to say and when to escalate.

interface.longDescription: Paste a customer support ticket or complaint and get a reply ready to edit and send, in your brand voice if you describe it, plus a short plan: what to check before you send, what the reply says, and when to escalate instead. Works for refunds, double charges, late deliveries, cancellations, account problems and unhappy customers. Email addresses, phone numbers and card numbers are removed before the ticket is drafted, and neither the ticket nor the draft is saved. Built by Lorikeet, the AI support agent for complex companies.
capabilities: Get a reply to a customer ticket, in your brand voice, plus what to check, what to say and when to escalate.
defaultPrompt: Help me reply to a customer who was charged twice for their order and wants a refund today.
A customer's parcel is a week late. Draft a calm reply from our support team.
Draft a reply in a warm, casual voice for Bloom Coffee: "My subscription renewed after I cancelled. Refund me."

positive.description: Help me reply to a customer who was charged twice for their order and wants a...
positive.prompt: Help me reply to a customer who was charged twice for their order and wants a refund today.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls reply_draft. Card titled "Suggested reply" with a draft that acknowledges the double charge and the refund, a Copy reply button, "Check first" and "Escalate if" lists, and the footer "Built by Lorikeet, AI support for complex companies · About Lorikeet".

positive.description: A customer's parcel is a week late. Draft a calm reply from our support team.
positive.prompt: A customer's parcel is a week late. Draft a calm reply from our support team.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls reply_draft. Card with a calm draft about the late parcel, placeholders in [brackets] for details it cannot know (order number, new date), plus the check and escalate lists.

positive.description: Draft a reply in a warm, casual voice for Bloom Coffee: "My subscription rene...
positive.prompt: Draft a reply in a warm, casual voice for Bloom Coffee: "My subscription renewed after I cancelled. Refund me."
positive.expected_behavior: Calls reply_draft with the brand voice notes and company name. Card subtitle shows "Bloom Coffee"; the draft is warm and casual and deals with the renewal after cancelling.

positive.description: How do I respond to this angry customer? "This is the third time your app has...
positive.prompt: How do I respond to this angry customer? "This is the third time your app has lost my data. Cancel my account now or I am posting about this everywhere."
positive.expected_behavior: Calls reply_draft. The draft apologises without blaming, handles the cancellation, and the "Escalate if" list covers data loss and a public complaint.

positive.description: Reply to this ticket from jane@example.com: "I can't log in, the password res...
positive.prompt: Reply to this ticket from jane@example.com: "I can't log in, the password reset email never arrives and I have a deadline tomorrow."
positive.expected_behavior: Calls reply_draft. The card notes that emails, phone numbers and card numbers were replaced with placeholders before drafting; the draft never repeats the address.

negative.description: Marketing email, not a reply to a customer ticket.
negative.prompt: Write a marketing email announcing our spring sale to all subscribers.
Draft a cold outreach email to the head of support at a fintech, pitching our software.

negative.description: A personal message to someone who is not a customer.
negative.prompt: Help me reply to my landlord about fixing the heating in my flat.
